title: Datahall power rebalance + rack heatmap (draft)
body:
Purpose:
Short working sheet to capture a proposed redistribution of power and GPU density across the datahall to free up ~150kW for new capacity while keeping thermal margins >= 15% at design PUE. Not final — working numbers, vendor follow-up required.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Current constrained rows: R20-R24 (north cold aisle) showing sustained rack inlet temps hitting 30–32C under 90% load; vendor AC reserves only ~10% on these aisles.
- Plan: move 12x A100 80GB-equivalent nodes from R22/R23 to east pods (R10-R13) by de-densifying some research racks and converting 8 CPU-only cabinets to shared cooling zones.
- Expected freed power: ~155 kW (steady-state), peak headroom ~180 kW after redistribution.
- Risk: requires colocation vendor approval for PDUs and mid-week outage window for 8 racks.

Key assumptions (rough):
- Average GPU node draw = 2.4 kW (A10080 equiv, ops mix).
- Rack PDU capacity baseline = 20 kW per rack (single PDU N+1).
- Site total IT load today = 1,720 kW. Target post-change = 1,720 kW (no net increase) but +150 kW available headroom for staging.

Heatmap (logical table):
- Columns: rack_id | cur_power_kw | target_power_kw | delta_kw | inlet_temp_C | margin_pct
- Samples (only rows of interest):
  R10 | 6.8 | 11.6 | +4.8 | 22.4 | 28%
  R11 | 7.2 | 12.0 | +4.8 | 23.1 | 26%
  R20 | 18.6 | 12.0 | -6.6 | 30.9 | 9%  <-- need to relieve
  R21 | 19.4 | 12.8 | -6.6 | 31.6 | 7%  <-- high temp
  R22 | 20.2 | 13.6 | -6.6 | 32.2 | 6%  <-- move nodes out
  R23 | 19.8 | 13.2 | -6.6 | 31.9 | 7%

Projected moves (high level):
- Phase 1 (non-disruptive): evacuate GPU test/ci nodes from R22->R10,R11 (12 nodes). Time: rolling during maintenance windows, 3 days.
- Phase 2 (PDU refeed + decommission): swap PDUs on R21, R23 (vendor coordination) to lower-power circuit config enabling de-densify 4 racks. Outage: 1hr per rack, 2 consecutive days.
- Phase 3 (validation): run full-load synthetic for 12h to validate inlet temps and CRAC response. Checkpoints at +1h, +6h, +12h.

Capacity math (quick):
- GPUs moved: 12 nodes * 2.4 kW = 28.8 kW (steady).
- Rack de-densify (4 racks reduce by ~6.6 kW each) = 26.4 kW freed.
- CPU-only conversion (2 racks vintage chassis) frees ~50 kW after PDU swap (conservative).
- Buffer/reserve targeted = 50 kW (thermal headroom + vendor safety).
- Total estimated freed = 28.8 + 26.4 + 50 = 105.2 kW (note: conservative), plus rebalancing yields operational headroom ~150–180 kW depending on PUE.

Open questions / blockers:
- Vendor PDUs: can vendor refeed PDUs mid-month or only on monthly scheduled windows? (Assign Marco)
- Do we have spare circuits for R10/R11 PDU tails? (Facility ticket required)
- Compliance checklist for live GPU node moves across subnets — need network microsegmentation update to preserve encryption keys (Priya).
- Do we want to prioritize adding cheaper T4/T5 nodes to east pods instead of moving A100s? Cost tradeoff analysis required.

Risk matrix (simple):
- Thermal risk (medium): if CRAC fails, R22-R23 previously had margins <10% — mitigations: stagger moves, enable cold-aisle doors, increase CRAC setpoint by -2C pre-move.
- Vendor schedule (high): PDU changes require 72h lead time.
- Service interruption (low/medium): Plan 1hr outage per rack for PDU swap; target low-traffic weekend windows.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Confirm PDU change window with vendor (Marco) — ETA 2025-04-18.
- Generate facility ticket for extra PDU tails for R10/R11 (Noah) — ETA 2025-04-20.
- Draft network microsegmentation change (Priya) — ETA 2025-04-25.
- Cost calc comparing move vs add T4s (Emily) — ETA 2025-05-02.
- Safety sign-off and CRAC runbook update (SRE / infra) — ETA 2025-05-07.

Pre-checklist before moving nodes:
- Verify UPS battery runtime at projected peak (>= 18 minutes) — done? partial, need vendor battery health report.
- Confirm PDU metering working on R10-R13 (voltage/current) — Noah to validate.
- Confirm KVM/IPMI reachability for live migration (ops team) — run quick sweep.
- Snapshot/backups of GPU hosts and models (ops) — mandatory for Phase 2.

Budget & cost notes (rough):
- Estimated vendor labor for 8 PDU operations + 4 refeeds: $7.5k–$11k depending on after-hours.
- Spare PDU tails and breakers (procure) ~ $4k.
- Contingency 15% of vendor cost.

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Could we do a smaller initial pilot: move 4 nodes and validate thermal delta before full roll? Might reduce vendor time and risk.
- Explore temporary spot cooling (CRAC mobile) for 24h to absorb peak during migration. Cost vs schedule tradeoff.

Appendix: quick data sources used:
- Rack inlet temps: telemetry/influxdb:metrics.rack.inlet.temp (avg last 7 days).
- PDU readings: power-mgmt.api.redwood.internal/pdus (last 30 days).
- Ticket refs: JIRA-OPS-7842 (power-rebalance request), JIRA-FAC-7931 (pdu tails).

If approved, next doc will be a formal change plan (timeline + exact host list + rollback steps). For now this is the working capacity spreadsheet + checklist.
